title: International Winter School on Public Policy – Doha Edition 2027
about: IPPA winter school on public policy, 17-21 January 2027 in Doha, co-organised with Hamad Bin Khalifa University, designed for PhD students and early-career researchers. Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis; courses are capped at about 10 participants.
requirements: CV; research abstract required for those who want their project discussed

upskill.name: AI Governance Academy

Seniority "PhD students and early-career researchers" → AI Governance Academy course AI Governance Fundamentals: "Explore accountability, transparency, fairness, safety, privacy, security, and meaningful human oversight as core principles of effective AI governance"
